text:
sam: hitting reproducible stream disconnects for a mobile app during network handoff. customer sees partial JSON chunks, then socket closes. repro on iOS and Android. any pointers?

anya: can you paste the top-level error and a short client log? also which SDK version + region?

sam: logs below. SDK 1.14.3, region=us-west-2, customer org: acme-ride, session id=sess_9y12. curl also repros from a laptop if I toggle wifi off.

```
[INFO] stream start id=sess_9y12 prompt_len=180
[INFO] stream chunk id=sess_9y12 part=1 data='{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hi, this is"}}]}'
[INFO] stream chunk id=sess_9y12 part=2 data='{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":" a test of"}}]}'
[WARN] socket closed unexpectedly: ECONNRESET from 10.12.5.8:443
[ERROR] client reconnect attempt failed: tls handshake timeout
```

sam: observed pattern: when phone switches from wifi -> cellular, we get 2-3 partial chunks then abrupt close. not getting retry behavior from SDK.

leo: thanks. initial thought: NAT/edge idle timeouts on carrier networks often drop upstream TCP; client sees reset and TLS layer fails on resume. is the client sending application-level heartbeats?

mike: also confirm token TTL; if token refresh is happening on background thread and connection is closed while refresh in-flight you can see aborted streams. but logs you pasted look like pure socket reset.

anya: steps I'll try with you: 1) run curl repro with `--no-buffer -v` and flip wifi off after first chunk. 2) capture tcpdump on phone or tether host to confirm RST vs FIN. 3) enable SDK debug to capture retry decision logs. can you run step 1 and share output?

sam: here is the curl command I used: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams/generate" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test handoff"}' --no-buffer
```

sam: output shows SSE lines then connection reset: `recv() returned 104 (Connection reset by peer)`

leo: if it's an edge reset, temporary mitigation is: 1) enable client-side heartbeat (send comment SSE `:\n` every 15s) 2) on reconnect, resume using `stream_resume_token` (we expose a resume token in the first chunk if you set resume=true) 3) bump proxy idle timeout on corporate proxies where possible.

mike: note: our server currently keeps an ephemeral resume token for 60s by default. if customer handoffs take longer than that the resume won't work. we can consider increasing to 120s for acme-ride if they need it.

anya: can you attach a concise repro timeline (timestamps) and the raw curl output? I'll open a support case and escalate to runtime team. also include device model + iOS/Android build.

sam: sending logs + timeline to case now. customer wants a workaround: is client heartbeat + immediate reconnect good enough?

leo: usually yes. heartbeat keeps NAT mapping alive. immediate reconnect with resume token reduces lost context so client gets remaining tokens in sequence.

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-3271 and linked to runtime oncall. https://support.redwood.com/cases/SUP-3271

anya: thanks — setting expectation with customer: we may need a short change to resume TTL and a docs snippet for mobile SDK recommended heartbeat. will follow up in the ticket. :thumbsup:
